 ----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajendra Singh Charan
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Singh Rajurohit, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Taneja
Order 07/10/2025
1.

By way of filing this instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.114/2021, registered at Police Station Pur, District Bhilwara, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 384 & 120B IPC.

2. Learned Public Prosecutor submits that after through investigation into the matter, the police has filed a negative final report No.68/2021 dated 28.12.2021 before the Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bhilwara.
3. The factual report dated 18.09.2025 filed by the learned Public Prosecutor is taken on record.
In view of the above, the present criminal misc. petition has become infructuous and the same is accordingly disposed of.
5. All pending applications stand disposed of.
